audit.why: 52.56% WR over 489 games for Naafiri; packet chart gives her every stage. Neeko needs to land E (12-10s CD) to do anything and has no dash. Existing diff TRICKY 7/10 looks harsh against the data — noted, not changed, since diff is mirror-coupled.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart said Neeko wins Level 6 and 2+ items while content and packet give all seven stages to Naafiri; whys at those rows already described Naafiri winning.
audit.why: Pop Blossom needs proximity and a visible windup — Naafiri's E dash exits the radius and her W untargetability dodges the burst; E-dependent single-target root loses to pack spread.
audit.corrected: Sides aligned to Naafiri across the chart with matching ratings and whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fifteen misgender hits (Neeko is she/her). Naafiri's dash repeatedly called 'W The Hunt' / 'W gap-close' — kit puts the champion dash on R and the untargetable pack-empower on W. Cooldowns field had no digits.
audit.why: Kit authority: her E 12s down to 10 is the whole setup; dodging it opens a free window. Her R 120/105/90 with hidden windup only while disguised.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed, W/R naming corrected across both layers, real cooldowns added.
